verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a financial-crime risk platform, so scoring account takeover, fake account creation, and promo/policy abuse is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers AML-oriented onboarding risk scoring, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and case management for those alerts. Nothing shows detection or scoring of account takeover, fake accounts, or promo abuse, and configurable onboarding risk scores are an adjacent capability that earns no credit.
